title: MegaWise Precision Food Scale, 33lb Waterproof Rechargeable Digital Kitchen Scale, 1g/0.04oz Precise Graduation, Weight Grams and Ounces for Cooking Baking, 5 Units Conversion, Tare Function
description:
About this item
SYMPLISTIC DESIGN: With a horizontal screen , simple touch operation- Weighing at the left, operation and display on the right, so that you can read the measurement and change the Unit conveniently and easily. A sleek scale to put on your counter to look good and work well.
MULTIFUNCTIONAL : This multifunction scale has multiple units: oz, g, b:oz, ml and fl'oz, include water and milk volume measurement modes, every units is easy to converse by the button “unit”. Use this digital weight scale for better cooking, baking, tracking intake, keto diet and weight loss.
EASY TO OPERATEL : The weigh gram scale is designed with two buttons and tare function, you can use it to remove the the weight of the container in order to get the exact weight of the object. Use the Tare button to zero out the weight of a container before measuring your food item.
USB RECHARGEABLE & TEMPERED GLASS : This food kitchen scale is recharged by USB, fully charged one time could last 2 months even you use it every day, compared to others with batteries, it is more convenient and environmental. And the panel use tempered glasses, which is anti-print and so easy to clean.
MEGA SUPPORT FOR YOUR PEACE OF MIND : We've got your back! Reach out to our 24/7 live chat and call support for any questions or concerns. With us, you're not just buying a product, you're gaining a styling partner for life. Experience the ultimate support and say hello to hassle-free styling today.

I've tried many different cables in addition to the one it came with as well as different chargers, none work to make it charge. Trying to figure out how I can contact them, will update if I hear back from them, if no update I've junked itUsed it for many months. The serving sizes are huge, and the package serving sizes of items are not correct if you use this product. That is how I first noticed something was off. I got only 2 servings out of a 3.5-serving garbanzo bean can.Worked well at the beginning. Now it can't weigh anything correctly. You can tare as many times as you would like and it still will tell you either what you are measuring is 300g or -70g. I would not recommend purchasing this product.
